claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to produce a specific dim-light radius. Light level is deterministic combat-facing state, but the current surface has no atom for granting or toggling illumination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet, either as a Bonus Action or after you roll Initiative, or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object_or_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The form-change mechanic targets the item itself, not the wielder, a creature target, an area, or a mark. `alter_item_kind` exists, but there is no honest attachment shape for item-targeted activations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod (for ease of storage) or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: component/form_state predicate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several riders apply only in specific runtime item forms. Existing gates only cover holding/wearing/wielding, not conditional grants keyed to the item's current transformed state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). ... Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ac scoped_to_triggering_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction does not grant a standing AC bonus; it applies only against the triggering attack. Existing `modify_ac` encodes persistent AC modification but has no count/expiry/trigger-attack scope.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you are hit by an attack while holding the weapon, you can take a Reaction to twirl the weapon around you, gaining a +5 bonus to your Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_range for weapon form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff temporarily gains the Thrown property with explicit normal and long ranges. v4 already has `modify_range`, but the current authored surface does not expose it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_after_ranged_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item returns to the wielder immediately after a ranged attack with it. The current surface has no way to express post-attack item return behavior for a weapon.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
